Updating from the full screen experience.

- **Update now works without leaving the full screen experience yourself.** Windows only shows its permission prompt on the desktop, so Lounge switches there (Win+F11) for the prompt, installs the update, and switches back.
  *Coming from 2.1.1 or 2.1.2:* install this version once from the desktop (`Install-Lounge-FSE.cmd` in `Lounge-FSE-2.1.4.zip`); from 2.1.3 on, Update now does it.
